text: Import existing files from Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud, or a local machine
quote: Import your existing files from Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud, or your local machine.

text: Natural language search finds results down to the exact timestamp, page, paragraph, or frame
quote: Search inside your files with natural language that's gives you results down to the exact timestamp, page, paragraph, or frame.

text: Automatically remembers key details across files, forming a 'second brain' of your data
quote: Poly automatically remembers key details, forming a "second brain" for you out of your files.

text: Official plugin works with Claude, ChatGPT, and VS Code for fast file workflows
quote: Use our plugin with leading agents like Claude, ChatGPT, and VS Code and make your file workflows insanely fast.

text: Automatic parsing, transcription, and indexing make files up to 20x faster for agents to read
quote: It automatically parses, transcribes, and indexes your files that make it up to 20x faster for an agent to read and understand them.

text: Flashback mode shows exactly what files looked like at any past point, down to the millisecond
quote: Go into flashback mode at any time to see exactly what your files looked like at any point in the past, down to the millisecond.

text: Official CLI lets you search and script against your files from the terminal
quote: `poly` is Poly's command-line tool: your files, searchable and scriptable from the terminal.

text: MCP lets compatible AI assistants connect to Poly via a hosted OAuth-secured MCP endpoint
quote: MCP clients can connect to `https://mcp.poly.app/mcp` (streamable HTTP). Authentication is OAuth: a browser window signs you into Poly on first connection.

text: Finder tags sync bidirectionally with Poly tags, including colors
quote: Finder tags sync bidirectionally with Poly tags, colors included.

text: Share files or folders with specific people or a link while retaining ownership and revoke access anytime
quote: Share a file or folder when the content belongs to you and you want specific people — or anyone with a link — to see it. You stay the owner, and you can revoke access at any time.

text: Conflicting edits are preserved so any version of any file can be recovered at any time
quote: Even conflicting edits are preserved, so you can recover any version of any file at any time.

text: Gives Claude Code persistent context and full access to your Poly files
quote: Give Claude Code persistent context and full access to your Poly files.

text: Journal entries are saved as Markdown files synced to a dedicated Mind folder
quote: New journal entries are Markdown files synced to your **Mind** folder.

text: Visual similarity search finds images that look like a reference image you provide
quote: Visual similarity — find images that look like a reference image you provide

text: Agent can perform multi-step tasks (read, search, write, organize) in a single request
quote: The Poly agent can handle tasks that span multiple steps — reading, searching, writing, and organizing — in a single request.

text: Vim keybindings can be enabled in settings for keyboard-driven editing
quote: Vim keybindings (enable in Settings)

text: Official plugin loads Poly memory at session start, teaches Claude to use Poly, and connects the MCP server
quote: The official plugin loads your Poly memory when each session starts, teaches Claude how to use Poly, and connects the Poly MCP server.

text: poly-cli agent skill teaches agents to search, read, create, update, and organize files via poly commands
quote: The [`poly-cli` agent skill] teaches an agent how to search, read, create, update, and organize your Poly files by composing `poly` commands.

text: Agents can spawn subagents, assign them tasks, track progress, and share learnings with each other
quote: Your agent can spawn its own subagents, assign them tasks, and track their progress. Moreover, agents/subagents can communicate with each other and share learnings.

text: Import existing notes and memory archives from Notion, Obsidian, Evernote, Bear, and more
quote: Bring existing notes and memory archives into Poly Mind from Notion, Obsidian, Evernote, Bear, and more.

text: Poly files appear as a real folder in Finder/Explorer, downloading on demand and syncing back automatically
quote: your Poly files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer, with files downloading on demand and syncing back automatically.

text: Journaling lets you write thoughts, attach files, and add broader project context day-to-day
quote: Journaling gives you a quiet place to document your day-to-day life. Write a few thoughts, attach files, or add the broader context behind a project.

text: Folders can be viewed eight different ways (Icon, Grid, Feed, Detail, Tree, etc.)
quote: Eight ways to look at a folder — Icon, Grid, Feed, Detail, Tree, C

text: Poly agent can write and edit files directly in your storage
quote: The Poly agent can write and edit files directly in your storage.

text: Agent can summarize, explain, or edit files, and automate tasks like organizing a folder
quote: Ask it to summarize, explain, or even edit your files. Automate tasks like organizing a folder.

text: Create a Shared Drive as a team's own storage space with its own members, roles, and archive
quote: Create a Shared Drive when the content belongs to a team rather than to a person. A Shared Drive is its own storage space with its own members, roles, and archive.

text: Connect Poly to AI assistants and code editors first via local CLI, then via MCP integration
quote: Connect Poly to AI assistants and code editors with the local CLI first, then set up an MCP integration.
